message.content:
This image is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, red, serif block letters across the upper section. Above the title is a red rectangular banner containing black text. Below the title, the words "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" are partially visible in red. A barcode and QR code are in the upper right.

The background image features a street scene with several multi-story, concrete apartment buildings. The building on the right is heavily damaged, with charred, blackened surfaces and gaping holes in its facade and balconies. The building in the center is also damaged, showing exposed interior concrete and debris. Bare, brown trees stand between the buildings and the street.

In the foreground, a gray van is parked on the right side of a wet, gray asphalt road. A man on a bicycle rides towards the viewer in the center of the road. On the left side of the road, two other people ride bicycles away from the viewer.

Large white text overlaid in the center reads "LAPORAN DARI UKRAINA" and "URA, GENOSIDA". Smaller white text below this describes details on page H.76. Other text at the top includes "Di Balik Rencana Pemekaran Papua H.22" and "Klitih dan Kekerasan Jalanan H.60". The date "18-24 APRIL 2022" and price "RP 50.000" are printed in the upper right corner.
